description: Create an X card — the big image/video with a headline or button that an X ad clicks through on. ONE destination: websiteUrl (a website card, with a headline `title`), leadFormId (opens an X lead form — headline, or a button with buttonLabel), or an app (iosAppId/googlePlayAppId + countryCode, a button). Media: mediaKey, or 2–6 mediaKeys for a swipeable card (upload_x_ads_media). utm {source,medium,campaign,content,term} is appended to websiteUrl without overwriting the URL's own. Read back from X; a card is used by create_x_ads_post(cardUri). Free.

adAccountId.description: X ad account id (list_x_ads_accounts); omit if only one is shared

buttonLabel.description: button text shown on a lead-form or app card

countryCode.description: 2-letter store country for an app card, e.g. US

googlePlayAppId.description: Google Play package id, for an app card

googlePlayDeepLink.description: Android deep link for an app card

iosAppId.description: iOS App Store app id, for an app card

iosDeepLink.description: iOS deep link for an app card

leadFormId.description: X lead form id from list_x_ads_lead_forms, for a lead-form card

mediaKey.description: one media key from upload_x_ads_media (single image or video)

mediaKeys.description: 2-6 media keys from upload_x_ads_media, for a swipeable card

title.description: headline, for website and lead-form cards

utm.description: UTM tags object: source, medium, campaign, content, term; appended to websiteUrl

campaign.description: utm_campaign tag appended to websiteUrl; a tag already in the URL is kept

content.description: utm_content tag appended to websiteUrl; a tag already in the URL is kept

medium.description: utm_medium tag appended to websiteUrl; a tag already in the URL is kept

source.description: utm_source tag appended to websiteUrl; a tag already in the URL is kept

term.description: utm_term tag appended to websiteUrl; a tag already in the URL is kept

websiteUrl.description: destination URL for a website card

name: create_x_ads_card
title: Build an X ad card
